You are writing SQL for Apache DataFusion, which uses a PostgreSQL-like SQL dialect.

The database has two tables:

logs(ts TIMESTAMP, level VARCHAR, service VARCHAR, message VARCHAR)
events(id BIGINT, user_id BIGINT, path VARCHAR, status INT)

`message` holds free-text application log lines. `path` holds HTTP request paths with query strings.

Task theme: find request paths with numeric resource ids, such as /api/v2/users/123/orders

Write 10 different, realistic SQL queries that an engineer analysing these tables would run for this theme. Every query must use the function regexp_like(string, pattern [, flags]) at least once to match text, for example in a WHERE clause or a CASE expression. regexp_like returns true when the string matches the regular expression pattern.

Output exactly 10 lines and nothing else. Each line is one JSON object of the form {"task": "<one-sentence description>", "sql": "<one SQL statement>"}.

unextractable_lines: {"task": "Find all log messages containing numeric resource IDs in API paths", "sql": "SELECT * FROM logs WHERE regexp_like(message, '/api/v[0-9]+/[^/]+/[0-9]+')}"},
{"task": "Count distinct user paths that contain numeric IDs", "sql": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT path) FROM events WHERE regexp_like(path, '/[^/]+/[0-9]+/[^/]*')}"},
{"task": "Identify log entries with API endpoints having numeric resource identifiers", "sql": "SELECT ts, level, message FROM logs WHERE regexp_like(message, '(/api/v[0-9]+/[^/]+/[0-9]+/)')}"},
{"task": "Find events where user paths contain exactly 3 segments with numeric IDs", "sql": "SELECT * FROM events WHERE regexp_like(path, '^/[^/]+/[0-9]+/[^/]+$')}"},

{"task": "Extract log messages showing API calls with numeric resource IDs in the path", "sql": "SELECT message FROM logs WHERE regexp_like(message, 'GET|POST|PUT|DELETE /api/v[0-9]+/[^/]+/[0-9]+')}"},

{"task": "Count requests by service that contain numeric resource identifiers", "sql": "SELECT service, COUNT(*) as request_count FROM logs WHERE regexp_like(message, '/api/v[0-9]+/[^/]+/[0-9]+') GROUP BY service"}]}
{"task": "Find all paths with numeric IDs in the third segment after the root", "sql": "SELECT DISTINCT path FROM events WHERE regexp_like(path, '^/[^/]+/[^/]+/[0-9]+')}"},
{"task": "Identify log lines where resource ID appears as a trailing number after slash", "sql": "SELECT * FROM logs WHERE regexp_like(message, '/[^/]+/[0-9]+/[0-9]+$')}"},

{"task": "Count service requests with numeric IDs in paths using case-insensitive matching", "sql": "SELECT level, COUNT(*) FROM logs WHERE regexp_like(message, '(?i)/api/v[0-9]+/[^/]+/[0-9]+') GROUP BY level"}]}
